---
title: "Before the course"
---
Nothing has to be installed before the course: day 1 ends with the tools installed and the data downloaded, with time to solve the problems that installations raise. What helps is arriving with the case in mind and the account that the raw files need.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd) | The original study and its data, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the replications. Every part of the course works on this case. | 45 minutes |
| The paper | Read the paper of the original author (OA), which day 1 discusses in full: its question, its data, its measures and its models. The reference is on the case study. | 1 to 2 hours |
| The account | Create a free account at the GESIS archive ([search.gesis.org](https://search.gesis.org)), which the download of the Eurobarometer files on day 1 needs. | 10 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Optional. If you would rather install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) before day 1, follow the steps for your operating system. | 30 to 60 minutes |
